name: Data-quality alert trace
summary: When a data-quality alert fires or a report looks wrong, the data team lead gets one investigation brief: the reports and people affected, the path the data takes, candidate causes ranked by the evidence supplied, and what to check next. It runs no query and changes nothing.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own published map of analytics and reporting work, and its own rules for prepared work: the supplied alert, lineage, change log and run log as the only evidence, every candidate ranked by stated tests and never called the cause, and a named data owner who confirms it.
